---
title: "Benchmarks"
---

```{r setup, include = FALSE}
source("setup.R")
results <- file.path("..", "..", "..", "site", "data", "benchmarks.csv")
meta_file <- file.path("..", "..", "..", "site", "data", "benchmarks.json")
have <- file.exists(results)
if (have) {
  b <- read.csv(results, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  # columns added with the other packages; older results files lack them
  for (col in c("origins_used", "origins_total", "measured_threads", "cmp_pairs_both",
                "cmp_only_peabiru", "cmp_only_engine", "cmp_median_abs_diff_min",
                "cmp_p90_abs_diff_min")) {
    if (!col %in% names(b)) b[[col]] <- NA
  }
  ok <- b[b$status == "ok", ]
  # the comparison with peabiru is made once per engine, city and task (with
  # the first thread count): copy it to the other thread counts
  cmp <- grep("^cmp_", names(ok), value = TRUE)
  key <- paste(ok$engine, ok$city, ok$task)
  for (k in unique(key[!is.na(ok$cmp_pairs_both)])) {
    src <- which(key == k & !is.na(ok$cmp_pairs_both))[1]
    ok[key == k, cmp] <- ok[rep(src, sum(key == k)), cmp]
  }
  meta <- if (requireNamespace("jsonlite", quietly = TRUE)) {
    jsonlite::fromJSON(meta_file)$meta
  }
}
label <- c("peabiru-cli" = "peabiru CLI", "peabiru-r" = "peabiru (R)",
           "peabiru-py" = "peabiru (Python)", "r5r" = "r5r", "r5py" = "r5py",
           dodgr = "dodgr", cppRouting = "cppRouting", networkx = "networkx",
           igraph = "igraph", pandana = "pandana")
lab <- function(e) ifelse(e %in% names(label), label[e], e)
task <- c(build = "network build", ttm_walk = "matrix, walk",
          ttm_bicycle = "matrix, bicycle", ttm_car = "matrix, car",
          ttm_transit = "matrix, walk + transit",
          accessibility = "accessibility, walk + transit",
          expanded = "expanded, walk + transit (50 origins)")
num <- function(x, d = 2) formatC(x, format = "f", digits = d, big.mark = ",")
```

How long peabiru takes, and how much memory it uses, next to the packages
people use for travel-time matrices from R and Python: r5r and r5py, which run
the same model as peabiru, and dodgr, cppRouting, networkx, igraph and
pandana, which route streets with models of their own. Every number on this
page is read from `site/data/benchmarks.csv` in the repository, written by
`bench/site/run.py`; the methodology, the charts and the reasons why each
package's answers differ are on the
[benchmarks page of the main site](../../benchmarks.html).

**These numbers are provisional**: the run date and the machine are listed
below.

```{r, echo = FALSE, results = "asis", eval = !have}
cat("No results file yet: run `bench/site/run.py` at the root of the repository.\n")
```

```{r, echo = FALSE, results = "asis", eval = have}
if (!is.null(meta)) {
  m <- meta$machine
  cat(sprintf(
    "Measured on %s, %s (%s cores, %s GiB RAM), load average %s when the run started; peabiru commit `%s`.\n\n",
    substr(meta$generated, 1, 10), m$cpu, m$cores, m$ram_gib,
    m$load_avg_at_start[1], meta$versions$peabiru_commit))
  eng <- meta$engines
  for (e in names(eng)) {
    s <- eng[[e]]
    cat(sprintf("- **%s**: %s\n", lab(e),
                if (identical(s$status, "ok")) s$version else paste("not run:", s$reason)))
  }
}
```

## Summary

```{r, echo = FALSE, results = "asis", eval = have}
n <- max(ok$threads)
for (t in c("ttm_transit", "ttm_walk")) {
  rows <- ok[ok$task == t & ok$city == "poa" & ok$threads == n, ]
  pick <- intersect(c("peabiru-r", "peabiru-py", "peabiru-cli"), rows$engine)
  if (length(pick) == 0) next
  p <- rows[rows$engine == pick[1], ]
  others <- rows[!startsWith(rows$engine, "peabiru") &
                   (is.na(rows$origins_used) | rows$origins_used >= rows$origins_total), ]
  cat(sprintf("- **%s**, Porto Alegre, %d threads: %s %s s and %s MiB",
              task[[t]], n, lab(p$engine), num(p$seconds), num(p$peak_rss_mib, 0)))
  if (nrow(others) > 0) {
    cat(sprintf("; %d other package%s %s to %s s (%s)", nrow(others),
                if (nrow(others) > 1) "s" else "", num(min(others$seconds)),
                num(max(others$seconds)),
                paste(lab(others$engine[order(others$seconds)]), collapse = ", ")))
  }
  cat(".\n")
}
```

Only r5r and r5py compute the same matrices as peabiru; for the street
packages the tables below also show how far their answers are from peabiru's.

## All tasks

```{r, echo = FALSE, results = "asis", eval = have}
charts <- list.files(file.path("..", "..", "..", "site", "assets", "charts"),
                     pattern = "^bench-.*\\.svg$")
charts <- charts[order(-as.integer(sub(".*-t([0-9]+)\\.svg$", "\\1", charts)), charts)]
for (f in charts) {
  cat(sprintf("![%s](%s)\n\n", sub("\\.svg$", "", f), fig_path(f)))
}
```

```{r, echo = FALSE, results = "asis", eval = have}
n <- max(ok$threads)
for (city in unique(ok$city)) {
  cat(sprintf("\n### %s, %d threads\n\n", if (!is.null(meta)) meta$cities[[city]]$name else city, n))
  tab <- ok[ok$city == city & ok$threads == n, ]
  tab <- tab[order(match(tab$task, names(task)), tab$seconds), ]
  sub <- !is.na(tab$origins_used) & tab$origins_used < tab$origins_total
  out <- data.frame(
    task = task[tab$task],
    package = paste0(lab(tab$engine),
                     ifelse(sub, sprintf(" (%d origins)", tab$origins_used), ""),
                     ifelse(!is.na(tab$measured_threads), " (1 thread)", "")),
    seconds = num(tab$seconds, 3),
    `peak MiB` = ifelse(is.na(tab$peak_rss_mib), "", num(tab$peak_rss_mib, 0)),
    `pairs both` = ifelse(is.na(tab$cmp_pairs_both), "", num(tab$cmp_pairs_both, 0)),
    `only peabiru` = ifelse(is.na(tab$cmp_only_peabiru), "", num(tab$cmp_only_peabiru, 0)),
    `only package` = ifelse(is.na(tab$cmp_only_engine), "", num(tab$cmp_only_engine, 0)),
    `median abs. diff. (min)` = ifelse(is.na(tab$cmp_median_abs_diff_min), "",
                                       num(tab$cmp_median_abs_diff_min, 1)),
    `p90 abs. diff. (min)` = ifelse(is.na(tab$cmp_p90_abs_diff_min), "",
                                    num(tab$cmp_p90_abs_diff_min, 1)),
    check.names = FALSE)
  print(knitr::kable(out, row.names = FALSE))
}
```

The difference columns compare each package's matrix with peabiru's over the
same origins; they are empty for results files written before the other
packages were added, and for tasks that are not travel-time matrices.

## Reproducing

```sh
# from the repository root, in a container (Docker; nothing installed on the host)
bench/docker/run.sh --out /tmp/peabiru-bench
# or with the packages installed locally; r5r needs a JDK 21
python3 bench/site/run.py --out /tmp/peabiru-bench   # benchmarks.{json,csv}
python3 bench/site/charts.py /tmp/peabiru-bench --preview /tmp/peabiru-site
```
